description: This file defines the EachPromise class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, implementing a promise that manages multiple concurrent promises with configurable callbacks and concurrency limits.

classes.name: EachPromise
classes.description: A class that manages multiple promises, invoking side-effect functions during their lifecycle, with support for concurrency control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EachPromise with an iterable of promises or values and configuration options for callbacks and concurrency.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the aggregate promise managing all individual promises, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Creates the main aggregate promise and sets up its resolution and rejection logic.

methods.name: refillPending
methods.description: Refills the pending promises queue based on the concurrency limit.

methods.name: addPending
methods.description: Adds a new promise to the pending list from the iterable.

methods.name: advanceIterator
methods.description: Advances the iterable to the next element, with locking to prevent recursion.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the completion of a pending promise and refills if necessary.

methods.name: checkIfFinished
methods.description: Checks if all promises are settled and resolves the aggregate promise if so.
